title: PlateSubgraph
description: The part of the provenance graph that could have reached one plate by as_of_t_ms: every entity with a time-forward path to the plate, what it carried at the start, and the edges on those paths (washes included), in time order. Producer: partner graph (ProvenanceGraph.subgraph). Consumer: verdict (Laya's final plate check).

nodes.description: The plate and every entity that an edge mentions.

start.description: What the entity carried when it entered the shift: a bin's profile, clean for tools, hands and plates, or unknown: true for an unknown history.

edges.description: Interactions on a time-forward path to the plate, in time order. Extra off-path edges are allowed: the plate check drops them before reading (kitchen/verdict/laya_check.py, on_path).
